_readme: Maps ESPN team_id to the real names league members actually use in text
messages when discussing trades and draft picks. Used by parse.py's team-key
matcher (load_manual_draft, and future manual_trades helpers) so 'Deejay',
'Ant', 'Tommy', etc. resolve to the right franchise, not just the ESPN team
name/abbrev/id. First alias listed is treated as the primary display nickname.
team_id 10 (Remember the Process) is Tommy's own team.
